tape: All 14 screens ran at defaults. csp-wheel returned 20 put setups: 13 on the Nov 20 expiry, 4 on Nov 6 (SMMT, NU, ZETA, FCEL), 2 on Nov 13 (STUB, SBET), 1 on Nov 27 (AMPX).
The screen flagged earnings UNKNOWN on all 20. Yahoo puts 17 reports inside expiry. NU (Nov 12, TMPro agrees) and APLD (January) clear theirs; FCEL has no forward date anywhere.
Chart trend on the 20 CSP names: 7 downtrend, 10 mixed, 3 uptrend. Worst 20-day moves: EROC -36.6%, FCEL -32.6%, AVEX -32.6%, APLD -30.5%, POET -29.7%.
Only 2 of 20 carry an IV rank: STNE at 100 and HIMS at 48.9, both CBOE 52-week. The other 18 have no rank tonight.
Eleven quotes are wide: SHLS, SMMT, STUB, NU, FIVN, SBET, BSP, ANAB, ZETA, FCEL, AVEX.
One correlation cluster (60-day returns, 0.7 linkage): APLD+POET. Gamma scan: 13 of 25 names in positive dealer gamma, 12 in negative.
